title: NWIS Canonical Telemetry Record
description: Version 0.1.0 MVP/prototype canonical telemetry schema for NWIS. Unifies historical, synthetic-demo, and future live telemetry sources through a single downstream pipeline. This schema may evolve as production requirements are established.

schema_version.description: Canonical schema version for downstream compatibility gating.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the telemetry sample. Timezone-aware. Must not be null.

well_id.description: Internal NWIS identifier for the well. Unique within the system. Must not be null.

source_system.description: Identifier of the upstream data source system (e.g. VLOVE, eRTMAC, NWIS_SIMULATOR). Case-insensitive by convention, stored as-provided.

source_well_id.description: Original well identifier from the upstream source system. Preserved for provenance. May differ from well_id.

source_row_index.description: Zero-based row index in the original source file or stream. Null if not applicable (e.g. live stream). Used for traceback to exact source position.

data_origin.description: Describes the provenance class of this record. HISTORICAL_SOURCE: derived from archived real-world telemetry. SYNTHETIC_DEMO: generated by the NWIS simulator for demonstration purposes. FUTURE_LIVE_SOURCE: reserved for future real-time feeds. Mandatory. Distinguishes real data from demo data at every downstream stage.

telemetry_status.description: Overall record-level telemetry status. VALID: record has usable sensor data. SOURCE_GAP: record is immediately adjacent to a detected time gap in the source; values may be unreliable. PARTIAL: record has some valid measurements and some missing. EMPTY: all measurements are null. DATA_ARTIFACT: record is suspect due to source data quality flags.

measurements.description: Container for all canonical measurement fields. Each field is a Measurement object (see $defs). A missing canonical field means the source provides no mapping, and is different from a null value meaning sensor was active but returned null.

depth.description: Drilling depth. NULLABLE: no verified continuously varying depth channel has been established in WELL-1. Source channel GS_DBTM is flagged as an unverified depth candidate only (5 unique values, appears largely static in this dataset window). GS_DMEA and GS_DVER are functionally constant and must not be mapped here. Leave null until a validated depth channel is confirmed.

rate_of_penetration.description: Rate of penetration. In WELL-1 (VLOVE), mapped from GS_ROP. NOTE: GS_ROP is functionally constant in this dataset window (1 unique value). Flag accordingly.

weight_on_bit.description: Weight on bit. In WELL-1 (VLOVE), mapped from GS_SWOB. NOTE: GS_SWOB is functionally constant at 0.0 in this dataset window. Zero must not be treated as missing.

rotary_speed.description: Rotary speed (surface RPM). In WELL-1 (VLOVE), mapped from GS_RPM.

torque.description: Surface torque. In WELL-1 (VLOVE), mapped from GS_TQA.

standpipe_pressure.description: Standpipe pressure. In WELL-1 (VLOVE), mapped from GS_SPPA.

flow_rate.description: Total flow rate. In WELL-1 (VLOVE), mapped from GS_TFLO.

hookload.description: Hook load. In WELL-1 (VLOVE), mapped from GS_HKLD.

block_position.description: Block position / travelling block height. In WELL-1 (VLOVE), mapped from GS_BPOS.

Measurement.description: A single measured quantity with value, unit annotation, source provenance, and quality status.

value.description: Numeric measurement value. Null indicates missing/not-recorded. Zero must be stored as 0, never confused with null.

unit.description: Physical unit of the value. Null or 'UNKNOWN' if unit is not verified from source metadata. Do not invent units.

unit_status.description: Verification status of the unit. VERIFIED: unit confirmed from source documentation. ASSUMED: unit inferred but not confirmed. UNKNOWN: unit not established.

source_channel.description: Original channel name from the upstream source system. Always preserved. Never null for HISTORICAL_SOURCE records.

quality.description: Quality / validity status of this specific measurement. VALID: value is plausible and within expected sensor range. MISSING: value is null (sensor not reporting). SOURCE_GAP: value is adjacent to a detected gap in source telemetry. INVALID_SOURCE_VALUE: value is present but flagged as physically implausible (e.g. extreme negative pressure). UNVERIFIED: value is present but source channel mapping or unit has not been validated. CONSTANT_WINDOW: value appears constant for the entire dataset window (functionally uninformative). ZERO: value is exactly zero — explicitly distinguished from MISSING.
